quality_rule.green: surface fit flag=0, calendar/butterfly violations=0, age<=5 calendar days, required ATM/RV finite, both ETF sources present
quality_rule.amber: same hard checks pass, but one ETF source is present or age is 6-20 calendar days; bridge weight is multiplied by 0.5
quality_rule.red: fit quality flag, any violation, age>20 days, missing ATM/RV/risk premium, or unavailable coverage; bridge weight is 0

interpretation.stock_dataset: P-measure forecast check: future realized volatility is observable, but it is not an option-implied Q-measure label
interpretation.etf_dataset: transfer check: listed ETF ATM IV is compared with future ETF realized volatility to test whether the trailing risk premium is useful
interpretation.selection_rule: do not select a production weight from this small sample alone; prefer the lowest stable error across dates and tenors, then confirm on future listed snapshots
